title: Tree with Small Distances
statementMd:
You are given an undirected tree consisting of $n$ vertices. An undirected tree is a connected undirected graph with $n - 1$ edges.

Your task is to add the minimum number of edges in such a way that the length of the shortest path from the vertex $1$ to any other vertex is at most $2$. Note that you are not allowed to add loops and multiple edges.

## Input

The first line contains one integer $n$ ($2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$) — the number of vertices in the tree.

The following $n - 1$ lines contain edges: edge $i$ is given as a pair of vertices $u_i, v_i$ ($1 \le u_i, v_i \le n$). It is guaranteed that the given edges form a tree. *It is guaranteed that there are no loops and multiple edges in the given edges.*

## Output

Print a single integer — the minimum number of edges you have to add in order to make the shortest distance from the vertex $1$ to any other vertex at most $2$. Note that you are not allowed to add loops and multiple edges.

## Note

The tree corresponding to the first example: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f93b6c673ae4bca503960c1088e7a5c4e8decdd9.png) The answer is $2$, some of the possible answers are the following: $[(1, 5), (1, 6)]$, $[(1, 4), (1, 7)]$, $[(1, 6), (1, 7)]$.

The tree corresponding to the second example: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7b3ddad84d287c70128981898a7f5bd1c4a9e617.png) The answer is $0$.

The tree corresponding to the third example: ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/adf37ddd5d0dfd7cf5b787de975b6bfb292535f9.png) The answer is $1$, only one possible way to reach it is to add the edge $(1, 3)$.
statementZhMd:
给定一棵由 $n$ 个顶点组成的无向树。无向树是一个具有 $n - 1$ 条边的连通无向图。

你的任务是添加尽可能少的边，使得从顶点 $1$ 到任意其他顶点的最短路径长度都不超过 $2$。注意，你不能添加自环或重边。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$2 \le n \le 2 \cdot 10^5$），表示树中顶点的数量。

接下来的 $n - 1$ 行包含树的边：第 $i$ 条边由一对顶点 $u_i, v_i$（$1 \le u_i, v_i \le n$）给出。保证给出的边构成一棵树。*保证给出的边中不存在自环和重边。*

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，即为了使从顶点 $1$ 到任意其他顶点的最短距离不超过 $2$，你必须添加的最少边数。注意，你不能添加自环或重边。

## 说明

第一个样例对应的树如下：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f93b6c673ae4bca503960c1088e7a5c4e8decdd9.png) 答案是 $2$，以下是一些可行的方案：$[(1, 5), (1, 6)]$、$[(1, 4), (1, 7)]$、$[(1, 6), (1, 7)]$。

第二个样例对应的树如下：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/7b3ddad84d287c70128981898a7f5bd1c4a9e617.png) 答案是 $0$。

第三个样例对应的树如下：![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/adf37ddd5d0dfd7cf5b787de975b6bfb292535f9.png) 答案是 $1$，唯一可行的方案是添加边 $(1, 3)$。
